summary: Neri bounty case state: orient, open with a frozen start record, gate-checked stage moves (ready also makes the HackerOne draft), owner asks, ranked programs with scope, drift check.

help:
Usage: neri [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Neri bug bounty case state

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  next     Holds, asks, open cases, top programs.
  show     Case card or program
  new      Start a case and freeze its hunt-start record
  advance  Move a case one stage.
  log      Log a history line
  ask      Ask the owner
  remove   Delete test data: a test-* program with its cases, or one test...
  check    Find state/file drift; with a case, scope answers or proxy policy
  program  Program policy
  hunter   Cases on hunter hosts
  hunt     Hunts in their sandbox: start, status, transfer, end,...
  egress   Live-hunt outbound hosts: ask, allow, decline, list, remove
  tool     What hunters lack: need, needs, set
help.next:
Usage: neri next [OPTIONS]

  Holds, asks, open cases, top programs. Why: pay N = payout band, g3/lab/dup
  = ratings 0-3, ? = unknown, dup/NA = earlier rejects.

Options:
  --needs HUNT  measured and booked figures for a hunt: source|lab|big-
                lab|live
  --json
  --help        Show this message and exit.

usage.when: start of a Neri session, and after an owner answer
usage.why: one call: cases you hold, answered asks, stale items, top open cases, top ranked programs
precautions: read-only
--needs prints only measured= (what the kind needs) and booked= (what a start reserves) for that hunt kind

usage.when: before working a case, or to read a program
usage.why: stage, gates met and missing for the next stage, last events (default 5, with import notes), file paths
precautions: read-only; gate output skips the secret scan

usage.cmd: st neri new <program> <slug> --asset A --class C --hunt KIND --searched TEXT
usage.when: starting a case; slug is yyyy-mm-dd-name
usage.why: copies findings/_template, adds the case row, claims it, freezes the start record
precautions: optional --version, --cost, --lineage (an earlier case of the same finding), --label
rerun is a no-op; label is generic: no target or evidence

usage.when: a stage's files are done; --dry-run lists what is missing
usage.why: checks the gates against the case files, moves the stage, sends the alert once
precautions: one step; killed, or hunting from candidate on, needs --reason
same stage again: resend failed alerts; ready/submitted/closed re-gate
ready opens the owner's submit ask and the HackerOne draft
replay and review need a session unlike the finder's; --take claims a stale case

usage.when: a fact, decision or dead end worth keeping in the case history
usage.why: timestamped history line; keeps your claim alive
precautions: 240 characters max; details stay in notes.md
--next sets the next step ('-' clears); --program, --asset re-scope the case
--release drops your hold; killed or closed cases take none
--peak mem=5.2G,cpu=1.5[,hunt=lab] records a measured peak for hunt needs

usage.when: the owner must decide, approve, submit or set something up
usage.why: shows on the owner page; the answer comes back in `st neri next`
precautions: title 200 characters, --detail 400
generic wording: no target or evidence

usage.when: test data is done; only test-* programs and their cases (or test-* case names) qualify
usage.why: deletes the rows, events, asks, approvals, case folder and ended hunt record; no undo
precautions: refuses real data and cases with a hunt still running; end the hunt first

usage.when: before committing in Neri Hunters; --host before touching a live host
usage.why: drift: stage vs files, stale holders, failed alerts; --host: in/out/unclear with the scope row
precautions: drift: no argument counts warnings by kind; a case or --all lists each; exits 1 on errors
--host exits 1 unless all in; unclear = skip and log it
--host/--policy-json refresh stale API scope first; stale manual scope refuses

usage.when: choosing where to hunt, or finding stale policy checks
usage.why: ranked programs first with a why line, then gated and untriaged ones; unknowns say unknown
precautions: read-only; rank is worked out on read, never stored

usage.when: reading a program's verdict, gate, recheck and cases
usage.why: shortlist row plus cases; same as st neri show <program>
precautions: read-only

usage.when: a policy needs a current check (candidate and ready gates need one); --all weekly
usage.why: the only writer of observed fields and scope rows on API platforms; before/after event
precautions: signed-out network read through queue_tool.py
stamps checked only when the policy is unchanged since the last check; else read it, then program set --checked

usage.cmd: st neri program set <program> [--verdict V --gate G --recheck T] [--g3 --dup --lab N] --evidence TEXT [--checked]
usage.when: a verdict or rating changes, or you read a policy
usage.why: judgment, ratings, identity, policy check; each change is an event
precautions: --evidence 'URL date: text' or 'provisional: text', max 240, for verdict or ratings
--checked: policy read today (refresh won't count a changed one)
manual platforms only: --state --pays --currency --scope --rule ...

usage.when: before starting a hunter session on a hunter host (neri-hunters) for that case
usage.why: the host gets this case's token and files; its st neri runs show, check, log, advance, ask, sync for it
precautions: one case per host; rerun after a host rollback
the host's files come back at each command, every few minutes and at hunter end

usage.when: the hunter session on the host has ended, before the host is rolled back
usage.why: last push of the host's case files, then the host's client, token and copy are removed
precautions: the host must be up; --abandon withdraws access without collecting files

usage.when: before placing a hunt on a hunter host, or to find a case to end
usage.why: each case a hunter host holds, with the host and when it started
precautions: read-only

usage.cmd: st neri hunt transfer <case> --to SESSION --from SESSION
usage.when: moving an already linked running lane between top-level coordinators
usage.why: moves lineage, questions, turn reports and egress routing without restarting the hunt
precautions: both coordinators and the lane must be on the same Tether
repeat the same command after an uncertain result

usage.cmd: st neri hunt start <case> [--kind KIND] [--tool TOOL] [--model M] [--reasoning-effort E] [--host VM|local] [--brief FILE] [--lab FILE] [--dry-run]
usage.when: a coordinator starts a hunt from its frozen kind
usage.why: needs, placement, grant, sandbox, session in one step; undone on failure
precautions: at_capacity or tool_unavailable lists each host's reason
--kind records a missing start record (old case); another kind is refused
rerun safe: a started hunt is reported, a broken one undone first

usage.when: the hunter session is done (or must stop)
usage.why: ends the session, pushes the case files back, records the measured peak, revokes access, removes the sandbox
precautions: a failed final push stops before anything is removed; rerun, or --abandon (files not collected)
exits nonzero while anything is left; the check lists it

usage.when: checking a running hunt, e.g. why it is paused
usage.why: the helper's live answer: container running/paused/stopped, each pause reason and since when, Nightshift disk admission (unknown when missing or stale)
precautions: read-only; a disk pause lifts itself on fresh green, and hunt end still works while paused

usage.when: deciding what to add to the hunt image
usage.why: each ended hunt's record lists, from its agent's session, the commands its shell did not find and the packages it installed
precautions: read-only; counts hunt records on this computer; no image is rebuilt

usage.when: after hunt end, or to recheck one that left something
usage.why: each item gone or left: Tether session and reservation, grant, container, sandbox, units, files
precautions: the ended record follows this check; a kept proxy store with no stop-time check is verified again; exits 1 while anything is left

usage.cmd: st neri hunt list [--host H] [--case CASE]
usage.when: finding hunts nobody ended, or before cleaning a host
usage.why: compares hunt records, each host's labelled hunt containers and each hunt's Tether session; each issue has its end or clean line
precautions: read-only; never powers a host on; an unanswered host or session is unknown, not clean; exits 1 on any issue

usage.when: hunt list shows a container with no record or an ended hunt's leftovers
usage.why: ends its Tether session, pushes its files, removes only resources labelled with that hunt id and revokes only its grant
precautions: refuses a hunt with an open record (use hunt end), an unanswered host, or unclear ownership; nothing changed
without a push (container stopped, grant gone, case hunted elsewhere) it needs --abandon; a VM proxy store is kept

usage.when: hunt list shows a record of a test case, or of a host that is no longer a hunt host
usage.why: ends its Tether session if still there, revokes its grant, removes the hunt record; case history keeps a forgotten event
precautions: only test cases and retired hosts; an open hunt or leftovers on a live host are refused
an open hunt's session that will not end keeps its record; a Tether reservation left held is reported

usage.when: the proxy blocked a host the hunt needs (package mirror, docs, source)
usage.why: one request to the hunt's coordinator, or the owner; the answer arrives as a message
precautions: ask once, then carry on with other work; no polling
out-of-scope hosts are refused

usage.cmd: st neri egress allow <case> <host> [--level case|program|global] [--reason R]
usage.when: a hunt's egress ask reached you and the host is fine to reach
usage.why: saved for later hunts at that level, pushed into running ones; the asking hunt is told
precautions: default program; case for a one-off; global only for hosts no program's scope names

usage.when: a hunt's egress ask reached you and the host should not be reached
usage.why: the ask leaves the pending counts in next and show; the asking hunt is told; a new ask is pending again
precautions: saves no approval and changes no policy; an approval saved later still applies

usage.when: checking which extra hosts live hunts may reach
usage.why: unanswered asks (state=asked) and every saved approval with its level, or those covering one case

usage.when: an approval should no longer apply
usage.why: later hunts lose it; running live hunts it covered get the narrower policy

usage.cmd: st neri tool need <name> --why missing|slow|broken|better [--tip "when to use it"]
usage.when: the hunt lacked a tool (or one was slow, broken, or a better one exists)
usage.why: one line; names asked for go straight to the image's needs list
precautions: the name only, no case details; the tip is 80 characters, generic

usage.when: next says tool needs are ready, or before changing the hunt image
usage.why: each name: installed, not_found and asked counts, programs, last seen, status, tip
precautions: read-only apart from recounting from hunt end records; close one with st neri tool set

usage.cmd: st neri tool set <name> --added REV | --declined WHY
usage.when: after adding a needed tool to the hunt image, or deciding not to
usage.why: closes the name in tool needs and next; an added one hunts still install shows again as not fixed
precautions: REV is the image tag or commit that added it
